race.comment: MISS TROMBARI (7) is the one to beat after her fourth in a BM62 at Morphettville, where she was unwanted in the market yet finished within a length and a half of the winner in Saturday company. The easier assignment, barrier 1 and 2kg claim all help, and she has already placed twice at this distance. On top. BUCKS NIGHT (2) brings a sharper profile than his ninth at Echuca reads, having been slow away, covered ground and still closed off from big odds, while the quick back-up and Alana Kelly returning are positives. LET IT RIDE (3) was plain first-up but returns to a trip where he has two wins and three placings from nine starts, with Todd Pannell booked for the second-up run. Include. THE TANK (8) knuckled down strongly to get within 1.1 lengths of the winner in third last start over 1400m at Murray Bridge when coming back from a spell. Sure to go well again.
